name: Top banner: cinemascope, top bar only
when: A headline over the shot without a plate on the picture: a letterbox matte slides down from the top edge and the title rises out of it, a small line first. For a quote's context or a framing title.
anchor: The scene starts as the voice starts the line the title frames (the title is up 1.0 s in).

vars.theme: clean or vice: the video's theme
vars.kicker: the small line above the title (In Rockstar's words)
vars.title: the title (the validated clip shows it in capitals: CAPTURED ENTIRELY IN-GAME)
vars.out: seconds after the start: when the title sinks back (the bar leaves after it; the scene ends 0.4 s later)

changed: The two lines and the exit time are values.
